sn4.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ upādāya bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
sn4.16:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
sn4.16:2.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ upādāya bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
sn4.16:2.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti
sn4.16:2.4: yannūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyāti.
sn4.16:3.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā pattā ajjhokāse nikkhittā honti.
sn4.16:3.2: atha kho māro pāpimā balibaddavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā yena te pattā tenupasaṅkami.
sn4.16:3.3: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn4.16:3.4: bhikkhu bhikkhu eso balibaddo patte bhindeyyāti.
sn4.16:3.5: evaṃ vutte bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn4.16:3.7: māro eso pāpimā tumhākaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgatoti.
sn4.16:3.8: atha kho bhagavā māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
